ZY TEST CODE (SYNTHETIC). This text was written for software tests. It is not the law of any place.

Sec. 2.1. The program may pay reasonable medical expenses.
Sec. 2.2. The program may pay for counseling at not more than $90 per hour.
Sec. 2.3. The program may pay for transportation to treatment, up to $50 in total.
Sec. 2.4. The program shall not pay for pain and suffering.
Sec. 2.5. A claim requires that the victim lost at least 7 days of work.
Sec. 2.6. The crime shall be reported to law enforcement, or to a victim advocate, or be the subject of a protective order.
Sec. 2.7. Residents of ZY may apply.
